description: This file defines a plugin entry for the Mistral provider in a plugin SDK, including functions for model hint detection, capability resolution, and configuration. It exports a default plugin configuration object with registration logic.

methods.name: isMistralModelHint
methods.description: Checks if a model ID string matches known Mistral model hints or their prefixes.

methods.name: shouldContributeMistralCompat
methods.description: Determines if a model should contribute to Mistral compatibility based on its API and capabilities.

methods.name: buildMistralReplayPolicy
methods.description: Creates a replay policy object with specific settings for tool call ID handling.
